about: Story lines read aloud, each fed to StoryEngine as one final utterance after the lines before it (balanced, playtime). play: sounds that must play by themselves; suggest: may be offered as a tap (or play); never: must not play by themselves.

lines: Oh no, a tiger is chasing you!
Look, the tiger is running away.
The lion opened his big mouth and roared.
There was no lion in the forest that day.
Once upon a time there lived a little kitten.
The bear was fast asleep in his cave.
Suddenly, a big bear came out of the woods!
What does the cow say?
The puppy barked and wagged his tail.
And then it started to rain.
It was a dark and stormy night, and thunder rumbled.
Knock knock! Who's there?
The fairy waved her wand and poof!
The wolf howled at the moon.
The little kitten said meow.
The dinosaur stomped through the jungle.
The owl said who who from the tree.
A lion was walking toward them.
He opened his mouth and roared!
The elephant went home to sleep.
She didn't see the snake.
The frog jumped into the pond with a big splash.
All the animals were quiet, even the lion.
The train went choo choo down the track.
The rocket was ready. Three, two, one, blast off!
The tiger came close, but then it ran away.
Remember the horse we saw at the farm?
The baby giggled when daddy tickled her.
The monkey is hiding behind the tree.
They walked along the beach.
A hungry wolf was sneaking up behind the sheep.
The sheep said baa.
There are no dragons here, only friendly sheep.
The bee buzzed around the flowers.
The cow mooed when the sun came up.
Grandpa was snoring in his chair.
The clock struck midnight.
The farmer climbed onto his big red tractor.
She rang the bell on her bicycle, ring ring!
A huge truck came rumbling down the road.
Nee naw! Here comes the fire truck!
A helicopter flew over the mountain.
The motorcycle revved its engine.
Beep beep beep, the digger backed up.
The little pig said oink oink.
The duckling said quack quack.
Duck down, the branch is low!
They played with the guinea pig.
The rooster crows, cock a doodle doo!
The hen clucked and laid an egg.
The donkey said hee haw.
A tiny mouse squeaked in the corner.
The crow said caw caw.
The elephant trumpeted loudly.
A dolphin jumped out of the water.
Then she sneezed, achoo!
The little bear yawned and stretched.
Baby bear came home.
The phone rang, ring ring!
The door creaked open slowly.
He slammed the door.
Everyone shouted hooray!
She bit into the crunchy apple.
A ghost floated down the hall. Boo!
The robot said beep boop.
The witch cackled and stirred her pot.
Fee fi fo fum, said the giant.
The knights' swords clashed.
A flying saucer landed in the field.
The fireworks went bang bang!
Once upon a time Snow White lived in the forest.
It started snowing outside.
A big seal popped out of the water.
The pirate ship fired the cannon, kaboom!
The guinea pig went wheek wheek.
He swung his baseball bat.
Suddenly he slipped on a banana peel!
The silly bear farted loudly!
Shhh, be quiet, said the fox.
The parrot perched in the jungle.
